paragraphs: Arly is youth program management software that puts every layer of program operations in one platform. The people who buy it run programs for children, handling enrollment, pricing and payments in the same place.

Families sign up through a customized portal with one log-in, completing forms and uploading documents. Billing and account processing sit alongside, with revenue tracked in real time. Participants are grouped and staff assigned to them for attendance taking and access to health and safety information. Check-in and check-out verifies authorized pick-up contacts in real time. An assistant called Arly Compass is described as part of the platform itself.

Curriculum is sold alongside the software, one set of it created in partnership with Scholastic. A summer package runs five to six weeks of ninety-minute daily instruction in reading, writing and math. Testimonials on the site are attributed to program staff at YMCA organizations, including the YMCA of Central Virginia. Staff onboarding includes self-paced learning and support from the company's customer experience team.
